note: Provisional High-Energy Turn (HET) parameters for Community Edition 2.670. All values are TO VERIFY against playtest captures. Angles are 16-bit angle units (65536 = full turn) as signed i32, NOT Q16.16. Durations are integer ticks at 30 Hz.
delayNote: Provisional: ~5.4 s at 30 Hz before the HET rotation starts. TO VERIFY.
defaultTurnNote: Provisional: 90 deg (65536 / 4) in 16-bit angle units, within the observed ~80-95 deg band. TO VERIFY.
turnRateNote: Provisional: round(50 * 65536 / (360 * 30)) = 303 integer angle units per tick (~49.93 deg/s at 30 Hz, observed ~50 deg/s). TO VERIFY.
maxSpeedNote: Provisional inclusive speed cutoff (table field). No HET was observed at speed 15+; exact boundary between 10 and 15 is TO VERIFY.
energyCostNote: Placeholder: HET energy cost and breakdown roll are TO VERIFY.
